newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman positive on Zeneca.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman positive on Zeneca.

text.p: Lehman Brothers gave Zeneca Group Plc an "outperform" rating on Wednesday and said a price target of 20 stg may be justified for the British pharmaceutical stock.
Lehman analyst Stewart Adkins said Tuesday's annual results from Zeneca were impressive.

"The growing recognition that Zeneca's track record at managing its earnings (and sticking to its promises) is excellent gives added credence to the belief that Zeneca can achieve its 15 percent per annum growth target over the next five years," he said.

"Standing on 20.5 times 1998 earnings and growing at 14-15 percent per annum, this stock offers better value than either SmithKline Beecham or Glaxo Wellcome and is cheaper than the quality U.S. drug stocks," he said.
"We believe that a multiple of 22 times 1998 earnings may be justified implying a target price of 20 stg, giving 10 percent upside."
By 0953 Zeneca shares were 5-1/2p firmer at 18.66.
